snippet.title: Meteos Astro Blocks Intro
snippet.description:
#meteos #メテオス
The intro of Meteos Astro Blocks, as found in the 176x208 version of the game.
Here's the transcript:
The year is 3999. The evil Planet Meteo has returned, causing devastating meteor storms on our planets, stealing our Energy Gems, determined to annihilate our galaxy. But all is not lost! We have found a way to defend our planets! Align 3 blocks of the same color to blast them back into the sky. Let's fight back against Meteo's attack!
